title: A rough transfer side met by a statement line within 10% takes the line's amount; the other side keeps its typed amount, and the difference is a fee on the sender (decision S1, answering section 14 question 1)
story: Set up Mon 4 Jan 2027 in pesos: the bank holds 20,000.00, of which 3,000.00 is what is left of Free to spend (typed), and an e-wallet holds nothing. Pay of 30,000.00 lands in the bank on the 25th (moved earlier) and starts the period; Free to spend is 5,000.00 a month. On Tue 5 Jan the person tops up the e-wallet and types it roughly (`est`) as 1,000.00 from the bank. On Wed 6 Jan the bank statement is read: 1,020.00 out on 5 Jan. It is within 10% of 1,000.00, so it meets the transfer's bank side, which takes 1,020.00; the e-wallet side keeps 1,000.00, and the 20.00 between them is a fee from the bank, in Free to spend. On Thu 7 Jan a second top-up is typed roughly as 500.00. On Fri 8 Jan the e-wallet statement is read: 490.00 in on 7 Jan. It meets the e-wallet side, which takes 490.00; the bank side keeps 500.00 and the 10.00 is a fee. On Fri 8 Jan a third top-up is typed roughly as 200.00, and the bank statement read that evening shows 230.00 out on 8 Jan: 30.00 is more than 10% of 230.00, so the line does not meet the transfer and is a spend of its own. Every amount is made up.

events.note: bank statement: 230.00 out, more than 10% away

asks.question: bank_today
asks.why: 20,000.00 (opening) - 1,020.00 (top-up of Tue 5 Jan: the bank side takes the statement line's amount) = 18,980.00
asks.note: 20.00 x 10 = 200.00, not more than 1,020.00, so the line is within 10% and meets the rough transfer's bank side [S1, Q1]. Before S1 a line that differed was a spend of its own and the bank showed 17,980.00.

asks.question: bank_today
asks.why: 0.00 (opening) + 1,000.00 (top-up of Tue 5 Jan: the e-wallet side keeps its typed amount) = 1,000.00

asks.question: headline
asks.why: 3,000.00 (Free to spend at the opening, typed) - 20.00 (the fee: 1,020.00 left the bank, 1,000.00 arrived) = 2,980.00
asks.note: The difference is a fee on the sender [S1, Q2], from Free to spend as no other place was picked [S5].

asks.question: bank_today
asks.why: 0.00 (opening) + 1,000.00 (Tue 5 Jan) + 490.00 (Thu 7 Jan: the e-wallet side takes the statement line's amount) + 200.00 (Fri 8 Jan, typed) = 1,690.00

asks.question: bank_today
asks.why: 20,000.00 (opening) - 1,020.00 (Tue 5 Jan, as the statement shows) - 500.00 (Thu 7 Jan: the bank side keeps its typed amount) - 200.00 (Fri 8 Jan, typed) - 230.00 (the statement line of Fri 8 Jan, a spend of its own) = 18,050.00
asks.note: 30.00 x 10 = 300.00 is more than 230.00, so the 230.00 line is more than 10% from 200.00 and does not meet the transfer: it stays a record of its own, and the person sees both [S1, Q1].

asks.question: headline
asks.why: 3,000.00 (Free to spend at the opening, typed) - 20.00 (fee of Tue 5 Jan) - 10.00 (fee of Thu 7 Jan: 500.00 left, 490.00 arrived) - 230.00 (the 8 Jan line, a spend of its own with no budget line) = 2,740.00
asks.note: AU (other points): in a life with a plan a spend with no budget line counts against Free to spend. Before AU it took nothing from it (2,970.00).
